title: 第1章 穿越成废柴第2章 族长护卫队
content_zh:
嘶——头好痛！
叶霄尘猛地睁开眼睛，一阵剧痛从后脑勺传来。
他下意识想抬手揉头，却发现手臂沉重得像灌了铅。
这是哪儿？
映入眼帘的是雕花檀木床顶，淡青色的帷帐随风轻摆。
身下是柔软如云的锦被，鼻尖萦绕着淡淡的龙涎香。
我不是在加班吗？怎么...
忽然，一阵撕裂般的疼痛从脑海深处炸开，无数陌生的记忆碎片如潮水般涌来。
青云城...叶家...玄气修炼...族长之子...无法修炼的废物...
卧槽！
我穿越了？
叶霄尘猛地坐起身，这个动作牵动了后脑的伤处，疼得他龇牙咧嘴。
他颤抖着摸向脑后，触到一层厚厚的纱布。
记忆逐渐清晰。
他，叶霄尘，青云城三大家族之一叶家的少主。
父亲叶云苍是叶家第一强者，玄罡境巅峰修为，却在三日前一次寻常狩猎中意外身亡。
原主听闻噩耗，悲痛欲绝之下，在奔跑中绊倒，后脑勺重重磕在台阶上...
就...就这么摔死了？叶霄尘嘴角抽搐，在这个能移山填海的世界，居然有人摔死了？
更离谱的是，这个身体的原主人还是个无法修炼的废物。
十二岁玄脉检测时，检测石碑毫无反应，连最低级的凡品玄脉都不如。

在这个强者为尊的世界，这简直是死刑判决。
老天爷，你玩我呢？叶霄尘欲哭无泪，别人穿越要么天赋异禀，要么系统傍身，我这算什么？地狱难度开局？
他深吸一口气，试着在心中呼唤：系统？金手指？老爷爷？
一片寂静。
芝麻开门？
没有回应。
天王盖地虎？
依然寂静。
叶霄尘长叹一声，认命地躺回床上。
既来之则安之，来都来了……个屁啊！
这可是弱肉强食的玄幻世界，没有修为连条狗都不如！
少爷，您醒了？
一个清朗的声音从门外传来，紧接着一个身穿青色劲装的少年快步走进。
少年约莫十七八岁，剑眉星目，腰间配着一柄长剑，行走间步伐稳健有力。
根据记忆，这是他的贴身侍卫叶凡，一个被叶家收养的孤儿，赐姓叶。
凡哥，有吃的吗？叶霄尘下意识问道。
肚子适时地发出一阵咕噜声。
叶凡明显愣了一下，随即面露喜色：少爷稍等，我这就去准备。
不多时，叶凡端着食盘回来。
简单的清粥小菜，却香气扑鼻。

叶霄尘狼吞虎咽地吃起来，余光瞥见叶凡恭敬地站在一旁。
凡哥，一起吃啊。
叶霄尘含糊不清地说道。
content_en:
Hiss - my head hurts!
Ye Xiaochen opened his eyes suddenly, and a sharp pain came from the back of his head.
He subconsciously wanted to raise his hand to rub his head, but found that his arm was as heavy as lead.
Where is this?
What catches the eye is the carved sandalwood bed top, with light blue curtains swaying gently in the wind.
Beneath her body is a brocade quilt as soft as clouds, and a faint scent of ambergris lingers on the tip of her nose.
Am I not working overtime? How...
Suddenly, a tearing pain exploded from the depths of his mind, and countless unfamiliar memory fragments came flooding in.
Qingyun City...Ye Family...Xuan Qi Cultivation...The patriarch's son...a waste who cannot cultivate...
Damn it!
Have I traveled through time?
Ye Xiaochen sat up suddenly. This movement affected the injured area on the back of his head, making him grimace in pain.
He touched the back of his head tremblingly and touched a thick layer of gauze.
The memory becomes clearer.
He, Ye Xiaochen, is the young master of the Ye family, one of the three major families in Qingyun City.
His father, Ye Yuncang, was the strongest person in the Ye family, with a peak level of cultivation in the Xuangang Realm. However, he died unexpectedly during an ordinary hunting trip three days ago.
When the original owner heard the bad news, he was so distraught that he tripped while running and hit the back of his head heavily on the steps...
Just... fell to death like that? The corner of Ye Xiaochen's mouth twitched. In this world where mountains and seas can be moved, someone actually fell to death?
What's even more outrageous is that the original owner of this body is still a waste who cannot cultivate.
When the profound veins were tested at the age of twelve, there was no response from the test stone, even worse than the lowest level of mortal-grade profound veins.
In this world where the strong are respected, this is simply a death sentence.
God, are you playing with me? Ye Xiaochen was about to cry but had no tears. Others who traveled through time were either gifted or the system was not around them. What did this mean to me? Starting on hell difficulty?
He took a deep breath and tried to call out in his heart: System? Goldfinger? Grandpa?
There was silence.
Open Sesame?
No response.
The king of heaven overshadows the tiger of earth?
Still silent.
Ye Xiaochen sighed and lay back on the bed resignedly.
Just make peace with it as it comes, come as it comes... what the hell!
This is a fantasy world where the weak eat the strong. Without cultivation, you are worse than a dog!
Master, are you awake?
A clear voice came from outside the door, and then a young man wearing a green suit walked in quickly.
The young man was about seventeen or eighteen years old, with sword-shaped eyebrows and starry eyes. He had a long sword at his waist and walked with steady and powerful steps.
According to memory, this is his personal bodyguard Ye Fan, an orphan adopted by the Ye family and given the surname Ye.
Brother Fan, do you have anything to eat? Ye Xiaochen asked subconsciously.
My stomach growled at the right time.
Ye Fan was obviously stunned for a moment, and then his face showed joy: Master, wait a moment, I will go and prepare.
Not long after, Ye Fan came back with a food plate.
Simple porridge and side dishes, but fragrant.
Ye Xiaochen ate hungrily, and from the corner of his eye, he caught a glimpse of Ye Fan standing aside respectfully.
Brother Fan, let’s eat together.
Ye Xiaochen said vaguely.
